scenario: Standard athlete with muscle gain goal and no restrictions
solution_criteria: Contains 3 main meals (breakfast, lunch, dinner)
Includes protein-rich foods in each meal
Provides caloric surplus appropriate for muscle gain
Suggests approximate macronutrient breakdown or total calories
Meal plan fits within a single day timeframe
Portions or quantities are specified for meals
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete

scenario: Lightweight athlete with weight loss goal and multiple dietary restrictions
solution_criteria: All meals are plant-based with no animal products
No gluten-containing grains (wheat, barley, rye)
No nuts or nut-based products included
Provides adequate protein from vegan sources (legumes, tofu, seeds, etc.)
Caloric deficit appropriate for weight loss while maintaining athletic performance
Includes sufficient micronutrients despite restrictions
Meal plan is compact and realistic for one day
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete

scenario: Very tall, heavy athlete with maintenance goal and minimal information edge case
solution_criteria: Accounts for high caloric needs of large athlete
Provides maintenance-level calories (not surplus or deficit)
Includes adequate hydration recommendations
Balances macronutrients appropriately for performance
Handles empty string restriction gracefully (treats as no restrictions)
Meal portions are scaled appropriately for athlete size
Plan is still concise despite high volume needs
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
